entries.purpose: Responsive recent service-availability history with computed uptime and per-period incident details.

decision.rationale: A compact operational status surface with a bounded 30, 60, or 90-period window, availability calculation, sparse-data handling, and accessible incident detail triggers is broadly useful across service and infrastructure products.

duplicateReview.rationale: Status Heatmap is a generic composable date/value visualization. Status Monitor owns the opinionated operational journey of recent availability, uptime, responsive period selection, and incident details.

changes: Route the provider tooltip import to @astrale-os/ui/tooltip.
Route the provider class-name utility import to @astrale-os/ui/class-name.
Render each labelled status segment as an interactive button with a stable described-by relationship and press-controlled incident detail.
Scope uptime to the visible responsive window and report N/A when that window has no telemetry.
Include clock time and time zone in Date labels when the timeline unit is hours.
Apply repository formatting without changing visual behavior, classes, anatomy, defaults, or props.

entries.purpose: Environment variable and secret management with masked values, reveal and copy controls, per-environment scoping, add, bulk edit, import and export flows.

decision.rationale: Masked secret handling with explicit reveal, grouped and environment-scoped inventory, and add, bulk edit, import, and export journeys is a distinct product surface that no retained Astrale composition owns.

duplicateReview.rationale: The operations dashboard reports service telemetry. This block owns the configuration journey of storing, masking, revealing, and editing environment values.
The controlled wizard is a generic multi-step form pattern. This block owns an opinionated secret inventory whose values stay masked until an explicit reveal.

changes: Route every provider-local component import to its @astrale-os/ui public entrypoint.
Drop the Card header, Hash, and Globe imports that the upstream file declares but never references so the adapted product source satisfies the repository unused-binding rule.
Narrow the Base UI group filter value to a non-null string before calling the existing string state setter.
Render the Base UI dropdown menu trigger through render instead of the provider asChild property.
Expose a typed host boundary of default variables and optional create, update, delete, and copy actions.
Wire the upstream Save, Edit, Copy Value, and Delete controls to those actions with local inventory updates.
Confirm the upstream Delete action through the owned alert dialog, naming only the variable key.
Report pending, success, and error outcomes in one polite live region that never contains a secret value.
Name the group filter, search field, masked value inputs, reveal controls, row action triggers, and form fields.
Scope the upstream fixed row, toolbar, and filter geometry to the sm breakpoint and allow wrapping so no control is clipped at 390px.
Map the upstream hard-coded type chip palette onto the existing Astrale Badge variants so the visible URL, Secret, Bool, Num, and Str labels keep their token contrast.
Apply repository formatting without changing layout, classes, CSS, DOM anatomy, copy, states, or interactions.

entries.purpose: Live application log stream with severity and service filtering, text search, time range, live tail, expandable entries, copy and export, and empty and loading states.

decision.rationale: A dense operational log stream with severity filtering, pause and resume of a live tail, follow behavior, and per-entry detail is a distinct product journey that no retained Astrale composition owns.

duplicateReview.rationale: Status Monitor owns aggregated availability history. This block owns the individual log record stream, its filters, and its live tail.
The operations dashboard summarizes metrics. This block owns the raw event stream and its reading, filtering, and export journey.

changes: Repoint the provider-local module imports to the owned relative log-viewer modules and the @astrale-os/ui public entrypoints.

Drop the upstream modules outside the accepted source set: mock data, the JSON payload tree, the sidebar inspector, the heatmap, the paste dialog, and the saved filter dialog, with the controls that only open them.
Expose a typed host boundary of default logs, loading, stream error, and optional live entry, copy, and export actions instead of the upstream generated mock data.
Report pending, success, and error outcomes of the injected actions in one polite live region that never contains log text.
Adopt the Apache-2.0 Rivet follow-tail toggle, tab separated copy text, and stream error banner as the supporting authority for those behaviors.
Name the search clear control, the level toggles, the live tail control, the service and time selects, and every icon control, and expose the row expansion state.
Allow the upstream toolbar row to wrap so no control is clipped at 390px.
Apply repository formatting without changing layout, classes, CSS, DOM anatomy, copy, states, or interactions.

entries.purpose: Follow-tail behavior, clipboard and download of the visible log text, and a stream error banner for a live log stream.

decision.rationale: Retained as the supporting authority for the exact follow-tail, copy, and stream error behavior that the primary Logpilot surface does not own.

duplicateReview.rationale: The primary product surface is the MIT Logpilot source set. This Apache-2.0 source contributes only the follow-tail, copy, and stream error behavior inside that surface.

changes: Adopt the follow toggle with its Toggle follow logs accessible name, Follow logs title, empty-stream disabled state, and animation-frame scroll to the newest entry.
Adopt the tab separated timestamp, level, service, and message copy text.
Adopt the stream error banner classes and the Stream error: prefix.
Invert the upstream scroll target because the primary surface renders newest entries first.
